name: Gleam Home Cleaning
tagline: The same careful cleaner, every visit.
service_area: Springfield, Riverside, Oak Park and Maple Heights
hours_note: Cleans Monday to Saturday, 8 am – 6 pm
response_note: We answer the phone ourselves and reply to every message within two hours during the working day.

promises.title: Insured and bonded
promises.body: Every cleaner is employed by us, background-checked and covered.

promises.title: The same cleaner
promises.body: Book a regular clean and the same person comes every time.

promises.title: Supplies included
promises.body: We bring plant-based products, cloths and a HEPA vacuum.

promises.title: The 24-hour promise
promises.body: Missed a spot? Tell us within a day and we come back free.

steps.title: Tell us about your place
steps.body: Rooms, pets, anything that needs extra attention. We confirm a fixed price before we book.

steps.title: We clean to the checklist
steps.body: Your cleaner works room by room through the Clean Facts list and leaves a note of anything they noticed.

steps.title: Keep the same cleaner
steps.body: Weekly, every two weeks or monthly — same person, same day, and you can pause any time.

art_direction.identity: A careful, honest cleaning company presented like good refill-soap packaging: a clean white canvas, pale rinse-blue label panels, navy ink, heavy and hairline rules, and generous whitespace. Calm, bright and exact — never busy.
art_direction.type: Archivo for every heading, price and label, set semi-expanded (font-stretch 116%) at semibold; Geist for body and interface text at 1rem with a relaxed line height. Prices and numbers are tabular.
art_direction.color: White canvas, rinse-blue surface for label panels and bands, ink text in two tiers (ink, muted), hairline lines. One accent: primary (glove yellow) only for the booking button, the rating seal and the ticks on the Clean Facts label. Text on primary uses primary-foreground. The closing booking panel is secondary (ink). Never add a second accent.
art_direction.signature: The Clean Facts label — the cleaning checklist typeset like a nutrition-facts panel: heavy rules, room-by-room rows, and a tick for each clean (Standard, Deep, Move-out). It is the answer to 'what exactly do I get?'. Keep it on the homepage and the services page wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Plain, specific and warm. Numbers over adjectives (three hours for a two-bedroom, from $140). No 'sparkling', no 'top-notch', no exclamation points, no promises the business cannot keep.
